description: This file contains helper functions and constants for image processing, including validation, reading image files, supported formats, and a memory tracker class.

classes.name: ImageMemoryTracker
classes.description: A class to track total memory used during image processing, with methods to get, add, and reset memory usage.

methods.name: readImageAsDataUrlWithBuffer
methods.description: Reads an image file and returns its data URL and buffer.

methods.name: isSupportedImageFormat
methods.description: Checks if a file extension is a supported image format.

methods.name: validateImageForProcessing
methods.description: Validates if an image can be processed based on size limits and model support.

methods.name: processImageFile
methods.description: Processes an image file and returns its data URL, buffer, size, and notice.
